run_qqapp_bot: run the QQApp bot that connects to QQ via botpy and handles c2c and group messages
build_qq_bot_class: build a QQBot class extending botpy.Client with on_ready, on_c2c_message_create, and on_group_at_message_create handlers
build_qqapp_send_text: build QQApp.send_text to split long messages and post them via QQ bot API as text messages
build_qqapp_on_message: build QQApp.on_message to process incoming QQ messages, deduplicate, check authorization, and dispatch to the agent
build_qqapp_start: build QQApp.start to initialize the bot client and run the event loop with automatic reconnection on failure
